-- SLAVE'S WORK --

for i, slaves in pairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
    if slaves.Name == "DestroySegway" then
        kill.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if string.lower(target.Text) == "all" then
                for i, c in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    local ohok = c.Character["Head"]
                    slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
                end
            else
                if game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text) then
                    local targetPlayer = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text)
                    if targetPlayer.Character then
                        slaves:FireServer(
                            targetPlayer.Character.Head,
                            {Value = targetPlayer.Character.Head}
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        btools.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local Tool = Instance.new("Tool", game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
            local Equipped = false

            Tool.RequiresHandle = false
            Tool.Name = "Destroy Tool"
            local Field = Instance.new("SelectionBox", game.Workspace)
            local Mouse = game.Players.LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            Field.LineThickness = 0.1

            Tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
                Equipped = true
                while Equipped == true do
                    if Mouse.Target ~= nil then
                        Field.Adornee = Mouse.Target
                    else
                        Field.Adornee = nil
                    end
                    wait()
                end
            end)

            Tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
                Equipped = false
                Field.Adornee = nil
            end)

            Tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                if Mouse.Target ~= nil then
                    slaves:FireServer(Mouse.Target, {Value = Mouse.Target})
                    local AttemptTarget = Mouse.Target
                    while AttemptTarget ~= nil do
                        AttemptTarget.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, -1000000000000000, 0)
                        AttemptTarget.CanCollide = false
                        wait()
                    end
                end
            end)
        end)

        naked.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if string.lower(target.Text) == "all" then
                for i, c in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    local ohok = c.Character.Shirt
                    local ohoka = c.Character.Pants
                    slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
                    slaves:FireServer(ohoka, {Value = ohoka})
                end
            else
                local targetPlayer = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text)
                if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character.Shirt, {Value = targetPlayer.Character.Shirt})
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character.Pants, {Value = targetPlayer.Character.Pants})
                end
            end
        end)

        nolimbs.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if string.lower(target.Text) == "all" then
                for i, c in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    local ohok = c.Character["Right Arm"]
                    local ohoka = c.Character["Left Arm"]
                    local ohokb = c.Character["Right Leg"]
                    local ohokc = c.Character["Left Leg"]
                    slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
                    slaves:FireServer(ohoka, {Value = ohoka})
                    slaves:FireServer(ohokb, {Value = ohokb})
                    slaves:FireServer(ohokc, {Value = ohokc})
                end
            else
                local targetPlayer = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text)
                if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character["Right Arm"], {Value = targetPlayer.Character["Right Arm"]})
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character["Left Arm"], {Value = targetPlayer.Character["Left Arm"]})
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character["Right Leg"], {Value = targetPlayer.Character["Right Leg"]})
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character["Left Leg"], {Value = targetPlayer.Character["Left Leg"]})
                end
            end
        end)

        hatless.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if string.lower(target.Text) == "all" then
                for i, x in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    for i, c in pairs(x.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if c:IsA("Accessory") then
                            local ohok = c
                            slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                local targetPlayer = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text)
                if targetPlayer then
                    for i, hats in pairs(targetPlayer.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if hats:IsA("Accessory") then
                            slaves:FireServer(hats, {Value = hats})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)

        sink.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if string.lower(target.Text) == "all" then
                for i, c in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    local ohok = c.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                    slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
                end
            else
                local targetPlayer = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text)
                if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer.Character["HumanoidRootPart"], {Value = targetPlayer.Character["HumanoidRootPart"]})
                end
            end
        end)

        kick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if string.lower(target.Text) == "all" then
                for i, c in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    local ohok = c
                    slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
                end
            else
                local targetPlayer = game.Players:FindFirstChild(target.Text)
                if targetPlayer then
                    slaves:FireServer(targetPlayer, {Value = targetPlayer})
                end
            end
        end)

        nuke.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            for i, c in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                local ohok = c
                slaves:FireServer(ohok, {Value = ohok})
            end
        end)
    end
end
